name: intel 8051 multiply 2 numbers
desc: A simple example of multiplying two numbers using the Intel 8051 microcontroller. The program multiplies two immediate hexadecimal numbers (25H and 04H) and stores the result in registers A and B.

files.sketch.ino:
MOV A, #25H      ; Load immediate hexadecimal number 25H into Accumulator A
MOV B, #04H      ; Load immediate hexadecimal number 04H into Register B

MUL AB           ; Multiply A and B (25H * 04H = 0094H)
                 ; Lower byte (94H) is stored in A
                 ; Higher byte (00H) is stored in B

MOV R0, A        ; Optional: Move lower byte result to Register 0
MOV R1, B        ; Optional: Move higher byte result to Register 1

HERE: SJMP HERE  ; End of program loop
